title: 情報伝送工学
subtitle: Transmission of Electronic Information
keywords: Fourier series and Fourier transform 2.Amplitude modulation and Frequency modulation 3.Continuous time system 4.Analog modulation 5.Pulse code modulation and sampling theorem
educationalGoal: This course introduces the basis of information signal and its transmission. For signal analysis in frequency domain, Fourier series/transform are explained. Frequency spectra of radio waves in analog modulations are analyzed. In addition to above, this course introduces the coding method named PCM from analog to digital and sampling theorem that gives the basic restriction for sampling frequency. For each topic, basis and principle are explained with basic formulas.
advice: This course is constructed following chapters: i) Basic topology of telecommunication systems, ii) Signal analysis method, - Fourier series and Fourier transform iii) Continuous time system, - Filters’ behaviors and their analysis - Quadrature modulation iv) Analog modulation and demodulation, - Amplitude modulation and frequency modulation v) Pulse code modulation and sampling theorem. - Pulse amplitude modulation and pulse code modulation - Sampling theorem
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Electrical circuits. Enough skill of mathematics (basic functions, integral calculus, complex number) How to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and calculate Fourie series for basic periodic functions.
Be able to understand and calculate Fourier transform and inverse Fourier transform.
Be able to understand basic properties of filters in time domain and frequency domain.
Be able to understand and explain amplitude modulation.
Be able to understand and explain frequency modulation.
Be able to understand and explain principles of pulse code modulation and the sampling theorem.

lessons.content: Course introduction 1. Basis of telecommunication systems 2. Basic mathematics for this course (1) - sine wave, exponential function, integral calculus
lessons.operation: Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding the objectives of class, basis of telecommunication systems and basic mathematics.

lessons.content: 2. Basic mathematics for this course (2) - complex number 3. Signal analysis (1) - Periodical function - Fourier series
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding basic mathematics, periodical function and Fourier series.

lessons.content: 3. Signal analysis (2) - Fourier series for periodical function - Fourier series for even/odd functions
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding Fourier series for periodical functions and even/odd functions

lessons.content: 3. Signal analysis (3) - Exponential expression of Fourier series - Fourier series for wave form shift
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding exponential expression of Fourier series and Fourier series for wave form shift

lessons.content: 3. Signal analysis (4) - Fourier series pulse train signal and its expansion to Fourier transform
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class. Understanding Fourier series pulse train signal and its expansion to Fourier transform.

lessons.content: 3. Signal analysis (5) - Fourier transform and inverse Fourier transform - Property of Fourier transform
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding Fourier transform and its property

lessons.content: 4. Continuous time system - Basic functions: multiplier, filters and quadrature modulator
lessons.operation: Exam Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding basic functions: multiplier, filters and quadrature modulator.

lessons.content: Exam 5. Analog modulation (1) - Principle of amplitude modulation
lessons.operation: Exam. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Prepare for the exam Understanding principle of amplitude modulation

lessons.content: Self-evaluation of the exam in previous class 5. Analog modulation (2) - Principle of amplitude modulation (continued)
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.

lessons.content: 5. Analog modulation (3) - Principle of double sideband modulation - Demodulation methods of radio waves with amplitude modulation
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.

lessons.content: 5. Analog modulation (4) - Principle of frequency modulation - Demodulation method of frequency modulation
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding principle of frequency modulation and its demodulation method

lessons.content: 6. Pulse code modulation and sampling theorem. - Pulse amplitude modulation and pulse code modulation - Sampling theorem
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding principle of pulse code modulation and sampling theorem.
